title: Telepathic projection test makes people mail tax forms to a West Virginia post office box
place_text: South-central Canada; Upper Peninsula of Michigan

tellings.quote: it was a deep inside report from ingos Swan that they had taken Pat price uh in the program up to Southern Canada

plain: In the 1970s, according to a man named Dan Sheehan, a secret program took a man named Pat Price up to southern Canada and Michigan's Upper Peninsula to test telepathic projection, meaning sending thoughts into other people's minds, and the test made ordinary people mail their tax forms to a post office box in West Virginia. Sheehan says he learned this from what he calls a deep inside report written by Ingo Swann, another man in the program. If true, it would mean the government had tested mind control on the public.
